initialExam.title: HPSC HCS 2026
initialExam.description: Haryana Civil Service exam for administrative and allied service posts in Haryana state.
initialExam.qualifications: Graduation with Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS (100Q) + CSAT (100Q). Mains: Hindi, English, Essay, GS-I to IV, Optional. Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 2 papers. Mains: Multiple papers. Interview.
initialExam.jobRole: SDM, DSP, ETO, and Haryana civil service posts
initialExam.careerGrowth: SDM → ADC → DC level through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit hpsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government accommodation, Vehicle, Medical, Pension
